name: 莊惠鈞
objective:
本課程幫助學生習得敘述、描寫、推論、議論、省思、說明等文體方面的寫作技巧，並指導學生從閱讀、圖片、日常生活事件，及課堂討論內容中取材，以加強邏輯思考和流暢寫作能力。
This course aims to develop and reinforce students’ strengths to create unified and coherent pieces of composition in a variety of styles--narrative, descriptive, argumentative, reflective, and expository. Students will be guided to write in response to readings, pictures, events in their daily lives, and discussions from the class. Thought-provoking topics dealing with current issues are used to stimulate and foster critical writing strategies. This course enables students to write and discuss logically and clearly; they also need to incorporate grammatically newly-built vocabulary into their writing.

W7	10/21	Post-debate framing analysis + revision
W8	10/28	Debate 3: G1 vs. G3
W9	11/4	Debate 4: G2 vs. G4

W11	11/18	[Reserved] Post-Exam Review
W12	11/25	Debate 5: G1 vs. G4
W13	12/2	Debate 6: G2 vs. G3
W14	12/9	Individual Consultation I (G1 & G2)

-----------------------

W17	12/30	Independent Learning: Debate Review 
W18	1/6	Independent Learning: Semester Reflection
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          W17 (12/30) Independent Learning: Debate Review
Students will independently review their debate performance, instructor and peer feedback, and refine their arguments and critical thinking skills.

W18 (01/06) Independent Learning: Semester Reflection
Students will submit a reflective report evaluating their growth in debate, argumentative writing, and critical thinking, and identify goals for future development.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          4
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          1. Review and consolidate the knowledge and CPFM skills developed throughout the semester.

2. Reflect critically on their development in debate for argumentative writing.

3. Demonstrate autonomous learning by evaluating their progress and setting goals for future improvement.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          [評量比例] 10%

Please refer to the *Evaluation and Grading Policy*.
